title: Continuous Wave
text: 恒定包络源建模；按 {Carrier frequencies} 指定载波频率；{Source type} 指定波类型 Ideal、{Constant in-phase value} 指定载波频率的同相调制、{Constant quadrature value} 指定载波频率的正交调制、{Source impedance(Ohm)} 指定源的输入阻抗、{Available power} 指定载波频率的可用功率、{Angle(degrees)} 指定功率波的相位角、{Add phase noise} 添加相位噪声、{Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} 指定相位噪声频率偏移、{Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} 指定相位噪声电平、{Automatically estimate impulse response duration} 指定自动估计冲激响应持续时间、{Impulse response duration} 指定冲激响应持续时间 1e-10、{Plot phase noise characteristics} 指定相位噪声幅值响应、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地，按实例取值。

params.name: Source type
params.values: 波类型 Ideal voltage (default) | Ideal current | Power

params.name: Constant in-phase value
params.values: 载波频率的同相调制 0 V (default) | vector of real numbers | V | mV | kV

params.name: Constant quadrature value
params.values: 载波频率的正交调制 0 V (default) | vector of real numbers | V | mV | kV

params.name: Source impedance(Ohm)
params.values: 源的输入阻抗 50 (default) | positive real number | complex number

params.name: Available power
params.values: 载波频率的可用功率 0 W (default) | vector of real numbers | W | mW | dBW | dBm

params.name: Angle(degrees)
params.values: 功率波的相位角 0 (default) | vector of real numbers

params.name: Carrier frequencies
params.values: 载波频率 0 (default) | vector of real positive numbers | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Add phase noise
params.values: 添加相位噪声 off (default) | on

params.name: Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)
params.values: 相位噪声频率偏移 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)
params.values: 相位噪声电平 0 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Automatically estimate impulse response duration
params.values: 自动估计冲激响应持续时间 on (default) | off

params.name: Impulse response duration
params.values: 冲激响应持续时间 1e-10 s (default) | scalar

params.name: Plot phase noise characteristics
params.values: 相位噪声幅值响应 button

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: RF 电路端子接地 on (default) | off
